title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
summary_full: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.
